evidence_span.text: our observations establish that NRP1 enables CDC42 activation and CDC42-dependent actin dynamics and filopodia extension in ECM-stimulated ECs, independently of VEGF-A signaling.

reviews.rationale: The paper causally demonstrates that Nrp1 (regulator) enables CDC42 activation to drive tip-cell filopodia/sprouting in mouse hindbrain, zebrafish ISVs, and human ECs, supporting the Nrp1→CDC42 arm of the mechanism, but it never investigates Cdc42ep3 (a distinct CDC42-effector gene, aka Borg2) with gene-specific data. Because the supplied gene Cdc42ep3 is not studied, no supplied gene can be credited as studied or function-supported here.
